topics.title: Safety First: Essential Training for Workplace Safety
topics.contentSummary: This module covers personal protective equipment (PPE), hazard warning signs, emergency protocols, and shop floor guidelines prescribed by ASDC and OSHA regulations.

slides.title: Introduction to Workplace Safety
slides.text: Safety is of paramount importance in automotive manufacturing plants. Trainees must understand all hazard classifications.

slides.title: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
slides.text: Mandatory PPE includes: Steel-toed shoes, High-visibility jacket, Safety spectacles, Ear defenders in high-noise areas.

slides.title: Hazard Signage & Color Coding
slides.text: Red: Stop / Prohibition / Fire equipment. Yellow: Caution / Risk of danger. Blue: Mandatory action. Green: Safe condition / First aid.

slides.title: Emergency Procedures
slides.text: In case of fire alarm: Cease work immediately, shut down machinery if safe, proceed via illuminated emergency exit to Assembly Point A.

slides.title: Operational Guidelines
slides.text: Ensure strict adherence to plant safety and operational protocols.

topics.description: Practical guide to maintaining Seiri, Seiton, Seiso, Seiketsu, and Shitsuke on the production floor.
topics.contentSummary: Comprehensive slide deck on 5S methodology implementation, shadow boards, visual management, and daily workplace auditing.

slides.title: 5S Methodology Overview
slides.text: Sort (Seiri), Set in order (Seiton), Shine (Seiso), Standardize (Seiketsu), Sustain (Shitsuke).

slides.title: Visual Management & Shadow Boards
slides.text: Every tool must have a designated position marked with visual outlines to eliminate search time.

slides.title: Daily Auditing Checklist
slides.text: Perform 5-minute end-of-shift 5S audit before machine handover.

president.tagline: Skill Development • Industrial Employment • Nation Building
president.quote: Our mission is to bridge the chasm between formal classroom learning and high-precision shopfloor demands through world-class vocational On-the-Job training.
president.message: Welcome to Kaushalya LMS — the institutional digital learning ecosystem of Yuvashakti Skill India Pvt. Ltd. Through Kaushalya, we are empowering thousands of young technicians across India with standardized learning resources, continuous OJT logbook tracking, digital assessment engines, and verified industry credentials. Every trainee enrolled in our dual-education model receives hands-on industrial immersion alongside rigorous safety, 5S, and technical competency building. We remain fiercely committed to nation building under the Skill India Mission.

visionMission.vision: To be India's premier benchmark vocational training foundation, pioneering industry-integrated dual-education models that transform young aspirants into globally competitive production professionals.
visionMission.mission: To empower 1,00,000+ rural and semi-urban youth by 2030 through industry-partnered On-the-Job Training, cutting-edge digital pedagogy, and recognized National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF) certifications.
objectives: Zero-dropout industrial apprenticeship tracking across all plant sectors.
100% compliance with Directorate General of Training (DGT) and NSDC standards.
Guaranteed post-training placement and upward NSQF career mobility.

aboutUs.title: About Yuvashakti Skill India Pvt. Ltd.
aboutUs.subtitle: Pioneering Dual-Education & On-the-Job Vocational Apprenticeship Since 2007
aboutUs.history: Yuvashakti Skill India Pvt. Ltd. (YSF) is an accredited vocational training organization dedicated to transforming Indian youth into highly skilled, industry-ready professionals. Operating in strategic alignment with the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) and National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC), YSF executes dual-system apprenticeship models across automotive, manufacturing, capital goods, and electronics industries.
aboutUs.accreditations: Affiliated with ASDC (Automotive Skills Development Council), CGSC (Capital Goods Skill Council), and ESSCI. Recognized implementation partner for NEEM, NAPS, and state skill missions.
